subject: SIG questionnaire initiation - Redwood (CardioGrove evaluation)
messages:

Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@cardiogrove.com>
Date: 2026-03-01T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: SIG questionnaire initiation - Redwood (CardioGrove evaluation)

Hi Marissa / Camila,

Thanks for the call this morning — good to get alignment on the integration scope. As discussed, attached is CardioGrove's SIG (v3) for vendors we evaluate. Please have your security team complete the questionnaire and return the file to me by EOD 2026-03-10 if possible.

Key asks from our side:
- SOC 2 attestation (Type II preferred) covering the platform/service used to process CardioGrove data
- Confirmation of HIPAA controls / ability to sign a BAA for PHI processing
- Data residency notes (US-only vs multi-region)

If there are technical follow-ups, loop in Tom (cc'd). If you need an extension, let me know — we can be flexible but would like to keep the review on the March evaluation track.

Attachment: CardioGrove_SIG_v3.xlsx (Excel, 120KB)

Thanks,
Priya Malhotra
Head of Security Operations
CardioGrove Health
security@cardiogrove.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Malhotra <security@cardiogrove.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-01T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation - Redwood (CardioGrove evaluation)

Hi Priya — thanks for sending this over and for the clear timeline.

Camila (cc) is our security/infosec lead and will own the questionnaire. Jordan is the AE and I'll keep him looped for timeline/contracting context.

A couple quick clarifying items to make sure we fill the SIG correctly:
- On Q24 (data processing locations / PHI handling) — do you want us to describe the default (hosted) architecture or also include our Dedicated/Private deployment options?
- SOC 2: you mentioned Type II preference — can you confirm whether the date range needs to cover the last 12 months or a specific audit window?
- Any sections of the SIG you consider mandatory for your security committee (e.g., encryption at rest details, SSAE auditor name)?

We'll start filling the SIG and plan to return a first-pass within 5 business days. Camila, let us know if you need anything from me to prioritize.

Thanks,
Marissa
Director, GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Priya Malhotra <security@cardiogrove.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-01T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation - Redwood (CardioGrove evaluation)

Hi Priya — thanks, we've got the SIG and will complete it. A few clarifications inline and a couple of artifacts attached that should help with a first pass.

Answers / clarifications:
- Q24 (where PHI is processed): Redwood's hosted API processes tokens in memory on ephemeral GPU instances; we do not persist PHI in our hosted runtime logs by default. We do offer Dedicated and Private deployment options where data residency and physical isolation requirements can be met; if CardioGrove requires US-only residency we can accommodate in our US regions.
- SOC 2: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II attestation for our inference platform with a reporting period ending 2025-11-30. I'll attach the SOC 2 summary report and the auditor name in the completed SIG.
- Encryption: We encrypt data in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest for persisted artifacts (S3) using customer-managed KMS options in Dedicated/Private. I'll fill in the KMS details in the encryption section of the SIG.

Attachments from Redwood (preliminary):
- redwood_network_diagram.pdf (PDF, 400KB)
- redwood_soc2_attestation_2025.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)
- redwood_data_flow.csv (CSV, 15KB)

Two small asks for you so we can tailor responses properly:
1) Please confirm whether CardioGrove expects the SIG completed for our hosted service only or also for Dedicated/Private variants.
2) Can you confirm the level of detail you need around logging/PII redaction — e.g., do you need sample log retention settings or an attestation that PHI won't be written to logs?

Once we get those answers we'll complete the SIG and send back a tracked changes copy for your review. Plan: first-pass back to you by 2026-03-08.

If helpful we can do a 30-min technical sync next week.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Senior Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com
From: Priya Malhotra <security@cardiogrove.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@cardiogrove.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-02T11:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation - Redwood (CardioGrove evaluation)

Thanks Camila — that level of detail is great and the attachments are helpful. To confirm:

- Please complete the SIG scoped to the hosted service first (we'll evaluate Dedicated/Private if we move to a committed contract).
- SOC 2: we need the Type II report PDF and the audit period (sounds like that's 2025-11-30 which should be fine).
- Logging: we need a short attestation that PHI will not be persisted in application logs by default and any logging that is retained can be redacted on request. A statement in the SIG will suffice; we'll follow up if we need sample retention settings.

Also — small ask: if you could add a short line confirming Redwood's willingness to sign a BAA for PHI processing (we will route BAA through procurement once we reach legal).

If you can get the completed SIG + SOC 2 PDF back by 2026-03-08, that keeps us on track for procurement review later in March. Thanks.

Best,
Priya
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Malhotra <security@cardiogrove.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-03T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation - Redwood (CardioGrove evaluation)

Priya — thanks for the confirmation. Quick summary and next steps from our side: 

- Camila will complete the SIG scoped to the hosted service and include the SOC 2 Type II PDF (reporting period 2025-01-01 to 2025-11-30) and a short attestation re: PHI/logging.
- Redwood confirms willingness to sign a BAA for PHI processing; legal/procurement language can be handled as part of contracting if we move forward.
- Target delivery: completed SIG + attachments by 2026-03-08.
- If anything is missing after your review, let's schedule a 30-min technical follow-up the week of 2026-03-15. Jordan, please add procurement contacts to the HubSpot deal and track timeline.
